definitions.explanation: A long, deep breath expressing sadness, tiredness, relief, or longing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{溜息|ためいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついた。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美|うつく}しさ→美しさ：27922_utsukushisa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溜息|ためいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{溜息|ためいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく。
examples.english: I let out a deep sigh.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わらなくて→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦{思|おも}わず→思わず：02549_omowazu⟧{溜息|ためいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The work wasn't getting done, and I involuntarily let out a sigh.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しくて→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、{溜息|ためいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}るほど→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The scenery was so beautiful that it was breathtaking.

notes:
{溜息|ためいき} means a sigh — a long, deep breath expressing various emotions. Often written in hiragana as ため⟦{息|いき}→息：noentry⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {溜息|ためいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく: to sigh (deliberate or habitual)
- {溜息|ためいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to sigh (involuntarily)
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{溜息|ためいき}: a deep sigh
- {溜息|ためいき}まじり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: with a sigh, sigh-tinged
- {溜息|ためいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}るほど→出る：00513_deru⟧: so [beautiful/bad] that it makes you sigh

EMOTIONS EXPRESSED:
- Tiredness, exhaustion
- Sadness, disappointment, frustration
- Relief (after tension passes)
- Admiration, being impressed (⟦{美|うつく}しさ→美しさ：27922_utsukushisa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溜息|ためいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ = sigh at the beauty)

CULTURAL NOTE:
There is a common saying: {溜息|ためいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (if you sigh, happiness will run away). Frequent sighing is sometimes seen as bringing bad luck or lowering the mood of those around you.
